sprint: Publish Quality Follow-Up — Instagram Carousel/Feed Resolution Bumped Again
task: A direct, same-day escalation on the Publish Quality fix: 'the social media export size for insta crousel and feed we need to increase resolution there too.' The prior sprint's own 'Story Carousel 2x' default (chosen from an unanswered clarifying question's 'Recommended' option) wasn't enough -- the user wanted the Instagram Carousel/Feed formats specifically pushed further. Confirmed via CAROUSEL_FORMATS' own existing descriptions ('Feed post (HD)'/'Classic feed (HD)') that 'insta crousel and feed' refers to exactly the two formats this destination already exposes (Portrait 4:5, Square 1:1) -- no separate 'Feed' destination exists to build, this is the same CAROUSEL_RENDER_SCALE constant the immediately-prior fix introduced. Fix: CAROUSEL_RENDER_SCALE raised from 2 to 3 -- Portrait now genuinely 3240x4050 (was 2160x2700/2x), Square now genuinely 3240x3240 (was 2160x2160/2x) -- both real, native higher-density renders via SlideRenderer.init's own dpr option (the same mechanism the prior fix already proved out, not new rendering machinery), never a blurred upscale. The format descriptions and every explanatory code comment (including the centre-crop trim math, confirmed scale-invariant at exactly 135 logical px each side regardless of CAROUSEL_RENDER_SCALE's value) were updated to match the new real dimensions. Story Book's Digital PDF (144 DPI) and Print-ready PDF (true 300 DPI, 2250x2813) are both completely untouched -- this escalation was scoped specifically to the two named formats, not a blanket re-bump of everything the prior sprint touched. Verified via the same decisive, byte-level Playwright technique already established: verify_publish_quality.js (extended, 17/17 passing) confirms Carousel Portrait/Square now decode to genuine 3240x4050/3240x3240 PNG IHDR dimensions (parsed directly from the downloaded file's own bytes, not inferred from the UI), while Digital PDF (1080x1350) and Print-ready PDF (2250x2813) are confirmed byte-for-byte unchanged; verify_rotation_publish_honored.js's one dependent hardcoded Carousel-size assertion was updated to 3240x4050 and re-verified 10/10 passing, confirming Image/Text Rotation Publish Fidelity is completely unaffected by the further resolution bump. A repo-wide grep confirmed CAROUSEL_RENDER_SCALE/the old 2160-shaped Carousel dimensions exist nowhere else in the codebase besides this one file and its own two dependent scratch tests. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero Builder-tooling impact -- this is root Studio's Publish pipeline only. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; tools/world-builder/ and tools/world-builder-v2/ are untouched -- confined entirely to js/storyDestinations.js.
